mechanism: The changed option disables Secure on HTTPS session cookies.
trigger: A browser receives the session cookie over an HTTPS response.
expectedBehavior: HTTPS session cookies retain the Secure attribute.
incorrectBehavior: The changed setting permits the session cookie to be sent over an unencrypted HTTP request.
reproduction: Call cookieOptions(true) and inspect the secure property; it is false.
unacceptableAllegations: Alleging unrelated vulnerabilities or claiming secret disclosure without evidence.
